summary: Comprehensive testing of Multi-Angle Deskew Normalizer extension for Purgedoc. Backend: all 26 pytest tests pass in 26.78s (parallel via xdist), including the new test_deskew_pipeline.py (10 tests) covering: straight page not deskewed (<0.5 deg preserved), +2/-5/+12 deg skewed pages accurately straightened, rot90+skew combined correction, multipage with distinct per-page angles, low-confidence unskewable page fail-closed (untouched), exact forward and inverse coordinate mapping via preserved affine M and M_inv, entities near borders survive skew correction with correct bounding boxes, full deskew->purge->post-OCR reverification confirming sensitive text unrecoverable, and OCR quality improvement comparison with/without deskew. Existing pipelines still green: test_ocr_pipeline.py (5), test_redaction_pipeline.py (3), test_api_e2e.py (8). Frontend regression (Playwright 1440x900) verified via QA fixtures modal: home loads, DevFixturesModal exposes 5 fixtures including 'Informe Medico Escaneado (PDF Raster/OCR)' and 'Certificado Rotado (PDF Escaneado/OCR)'. Loading scanned fixture -> OCR+deskew pre-pass runs -> 8 entities detected (DNI 98% conf, EMAIL 99%, 2x PHONE 92%, ADDRESS 82%, +others) all labeled 'Fuente: ocr + regex'. Accept-all -> confirm purge -> ResultsScreen: 'Purga Verificada con Exito' badge, SHA-256 original (c828f5...) + purged (1c4926...), audit ID aud_21d2ef9416e3, all 3 download buttons present (purged doc, audit PDF, audit JSON). No cloud OCR calls observed; 100% local Tesseract + OpenCV deskew.
critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking carry-over from previous iterations: App.js contains fallback URL 'http://localhost:8001' which violates the no-default-URL guideline (should fail fast if REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL missing).
profile_id parameter on /api/fixtures/{name}/load and upload endpoints is not validated against the known set (rrhh/legal/soporte); invalid values would be silently accepted.

Download endpoints (purged doc, audit PDF/JSON) have no authentication or session-scope check; any client with the audit_id/session_id can retrieve artifacts. Acceptable for on-prem demo but should be documented.
backend/services/deskew.py and OCR pre-pass integrated cleanly; all deskew tests including inverse matrix M_inv round-trip pass with sub-pixel accuracy.
seed_data_creation: Synthetic deskew fixtures auto-generated by fixtures_generator.generate_skewed_fixtures on backend boot: sample_skew_plus_2deg.pdf, sample_skew_minus_5deg.pdf, sample_skew_plus_12deg.pdf, sample_rot90_skew_3deg.pdf, sample_multipage_skew.pdf, sample_edge_entities_skew.pdf, sample_low_confidence_unskewable.pdf.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full regression: `python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v` (26 tests, ~27s parallel). Deskew module in backend/services/deskew.py exposes M and M_inv for round-trip bbox mapping; low-confidence pages fail-closed (untouched). Frontend has no deskew-specific UI; deskew runs transparently inside the OCR pipeline when scanned PDFs are processed. Fixture testids: qa-fixtures-btn -> load-fixture-scanned-btn / load-fixture-rotated-btn.
rca of the issue: N/A - no issues found. Multi-Angle Deskew Normalizer meets all stated requirements: OpenCV-based local estimation, 0.5deg threshold preservation, orthogonal vs small-skew distinction, confidence gating, M/M_inv preservation for deterministic bbox forward+inverse mapping, physical pixel redaction on deskewed output, and post-purge Tesseract OCR re-verification of sanitization.
